script.speaker: N
script.text: Last spring, our school started a Green Corner project. Students collect used bottles and old paper at the school gate every Friday afternoon. The bottles are sold to a recycling centre, and the money is used to buy books for the school library. Last year the project collected one thousand two hundred bottles and raised four hundred and eighty yuan. This year more students have joined, and the school has already bought over sixty new books. Our maths teacher, Ms. Wang, says she hopes the project will continue long after she retires. It teaches children that small actions can make a big difference, she said.

questions.prompt: When do students collect the bottles?
How much money did the project raise last year?
What does Ms. Wang think of the project?
options: It should stop when she retires.
It teaches children that small actions matter.
keywords: small actions can make a big difference

script.speaker: N
script.text: The city has more than three hundred small parks. Last year, students from a middle school in the city visited all of them in one week as part of a school project. They took photos, counted the trees and talked to the park keepers. Their report surprised everyone. Twenty of the parks had no drinking fountains, and forty-three had no lights after dark. The students then wrote to the city council and asked for help. Three months later, the council agreed to put in twelve fountains and ninety new lamps. A teacher, Ms. Chen, was pleased. Students often think small problems are useless to report, she said, but they wrote to the government, and the government answered. The school has now decided to publish the project in its school newspaper.

questions.prompt: How many small parks are there in the city?
keywords: more than three hundred small parks

questions.prompt: What did the students do during the project?
options: They collected information about the parks.

questions.prompt: What surprised everyone in the report?
What did the city council agree to do?
keywords: twelve fountains and ninety new lamps

questions.prompt: What has the school decided to do?
options: To publish the project in its school newspaper.
To visit more parks next year.
keywords: publish the project in its school newspaper
